debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 65.7, Stoch 89.16, Williams %R), weak ADX trend strength (19.87), negative CMF, below-average volume, zero fundamental conviction, high earnings risk within 61 days, and macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, NFP event today) create excessive headwinds that outweigh technical setup.
